competency.title: Reproduce observability — few shot
competency.outcome: Reproduce a stated result for observability using a metric-trace-alert contract. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in a metric-trace-alert contract.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report detection delay and false-alert rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: logging sensitive prompts into dashboards.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of observability.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report detection delay and false-alert rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for logging sensitive prompts into dashboards; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
